description:
The password normalisation in isolation. The user id is typed in upper case, so :132-134 is an identity move and cannot be what makes this case pass; only the password is lower case, so the sign-on depends entirely on :135-136. A translation that normalised the key and forgot the password would pass case02, case03, case09 and case10 - which all normalise both or neither - and fail exactly here. It signs on as a regular user and reaches :237.

USRSEC is seeded from app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, whose ten in-stream rows are 57 characters where app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy declares 80: SEC-USR-ID X(08) at 0, SEC-USR-FNAME X(20) at 8, SEC-USR-LNAME X(20) at 28, SEC-USR-PWD X(08) at 48, SEC-USR-TYPE X(01) at 56 - which is 57 - then SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) at 57, which is 80. The 23-byte shortfall is supplied once at seed time by the declared USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation and never hand-padded, and the 80-character expectedFinalState images prove that span was emitted as 23 spaces - a record missing it would be short by exactly 23. The same job corroborates the target width twice, with DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) on SYSUT2 and RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0) on the cluster. The dataset is addressed by its binding key USRSEC - the CICS file name at :39 - and never by a dataset name. expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion: COSGN00C contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE on any path, and the read at :211-219 does not even specify UPDATE, so it takes no lock and holds no record. expectedReturnCode is 0 because grep -c RETURN-CODE over the program is 0.

Determinism and the two substitutions. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO opens with MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA at :179, so the clock is pinned rather than read: 2022-07-19T23:12:33, traceable to this program's own version footer at :259 and expressed as a fixed local date-time so no timezone can shift it. Through app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY is MM '/' DD '/' YY with YY taken from WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2), giving CURDATEO exactly 07/19/22 at its PIC X(8); WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS is HH ':' MM ':' SS, eight bytes, moved into CURTIMEO which app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY:122 declares PIC X(9) - hence 23:12:33 followed by exactly one trailing space. Note that width: the sibling COUSR02 map declares its CURTIMEO PIC X(8) and the two must not be conflated. APPLID and SYSID come from EXEC CICS ASSIGN at :198-204, which has no Java equivalent and which neither application.yml nor application-test.yml binds, so CICSAWS1 and AWS1 space-padded to PIC X(8) are pinned constants standing in for those two calls; all twenty cases use the same pair, and the substitution is stated rather than hidden.

Provenance. Every expected value above is statically derived - by structured reading of app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl cross-checked against app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy for the record layout, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy for the communication area, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy and app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy and app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy for the literals and the header, app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY with app/bms/COSGN00.bms for the screen field shapes, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD for transaction CC00, and app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 for the ten seed rows. It was never captured from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand.

The unit is SignOnService, driven as a plain object with a fixture-backed SecUserRepository, and the eleven-field screen is projected by SignOnController, also a plain object - no MockMvc, no HTTP, no servlet container and no JobLauncher in the path. All conversation state travels in the payload, so no server-side session exists to hold any of it. The password stays plaintext because app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:223 compares it in plaintext; that is an inherited property of the legacy design and an explicit non-goal of this migration, not something to correct here. Neither the backward-GO TO restructuring gate nor the abend gate applies: grep -c "GO TO" and grep -c CEE3ABD over app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl are both 0, and neither is faked.
